channel.title: Farsçadan (English)
channel.description: AI-assisted English translations of selected stories from Iran's Persian-language press. Every story notes the outlet's political orientation.

item.title: WSJ: U.S. strikes Qeshm Island ahead of midterm election; explosions reported
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: According to WSJ, U.S. conducted covert strike on Qeshm Island; Iranian press reported explosions and alleged drone shootdowns on the island and Bandar Lengeh. (Source: Hamshahri)

item.title: Khabaronline portrait of Öcalan: from armed separatism to "political era" rhetoric
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Iranian news outlet Khabaronline profiled PKK founder Abdullah Öcalan's life and the organization's 2025 weapons-laying-down decision. (Source: Khabaronline)

item.title: ADNOC CEO: War against Iran has consumed 1 billion barrels from global oil reserves
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: UAE's ADNOC said 1 billion barrels have been drawn from global stockpiles since the war against Iran began. (Source: Hamshahri)

item.title: Vance says progress has been made in Iran talks ahead of U.S. midterm elections
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: U.S. Vice President Vance said progress has been made in talks with Iran before the midterms; Iranian press reported the claim with conditions and caveats. (Source: ISNA)

item.title: Witkoff: Trilateral U.S.-Russia-Ukraine talks set for November 10-11 in Abu Dhabi
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: U.S. presidential special envoy Witkoff announced that representatives of the U.S., Russia, and Ukraine will hold trilateral talks November 10-11 in Abu Dhabi. (Source: Donya-ye Eghtesad)

item.title: Axios: Iran-U.S. talks in Doha went positively; Araghchi says 'no definitive conclusion'
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Axios reported Iran's delegation left Doha Sunday morning; Araghchi said no direct talks were planned and no final outcome reached. (Source: Donya-ye Eghtesad)

item.title: Tanker struck in Persian Gulf; Revolutionary Guards claim separate mine incident
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: UKMTO reported a tanker struck by two unidentified objects off Saudi Arabia; the Guards separately claimed a mine strike. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: ElBaradei: A new U.S. attack on Iran would be 'complete madness'
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Former IAEA chief Mohamed ElBaradei called a new U.S. military strike on Iran 'complete madness.' (Source: ISNA)

item.title: Iran Parliament revives NPT withdrawal proposal: at least 10 bills awaiting
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Iranian lawmakers demanded Parliament take up NPT withdrawal bills; one said 'nuclear weapons are our right.' (Source: Kayhan)

item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Somali pirates hijacked a fishing vessel carrying 21 Iranians and 2 Somali security guards in the Indian Ocean; crew status unclear. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Week's Frame (Oct 26-Nov 1): Between war-restart signals and diplomacy
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Persian press, Oct 26-Nov 1: Israel election crisis, U.S. war-prep signals, Qatar diplomacy, fourth tanker at Hormuz, Turkey dimension. (Source: Farsçadan)

item.title: WSJ: Trump spoke with Netanyahu as U.S. prepared to resume Iran strikes
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Trump spoke with Netanyahu as the U.S. prepared to resume Iran strikes, according to the Wall Street Journal; the call followed military consultations. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Fidan: Closure of Strait of Hormuz imposing heavy burden on global economy
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said that the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, combined with the Ukraine war, is imposing a heavy burden on the global economy. (Source: ISNA)

item.title: Ulyanov: Europe played key role in laying groundwork for U.S. strikes on Iran
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Russia's Vienna envoy accused Europe of laying groundwork for U.S. strikes on Iran, responding to Germany's call for ending the conflict. (Source: ISNA)

item.title: FBI formally links $6 billion Binance hack to North Korea
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: The FBI formally linked approximately $6 billion in digital assets stolen from Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, to North Korea. (Source: ISNA)

item.title: UK maritime authority reports unauthorized boarding of fishing vessel in Arabian Sea
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: UKMTO reported unauthorized persons boarded a large fishing vessel in Arabian Sea waters; authorities assess it may be linked to organized piracy. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Fourth tanker caught fire in Hormuz: Sepah says mine, FT says attack
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: A supertanker caught fire in Hormuz; Sepah blamed a mine, FT reported deliberate attack with sticky mine. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: U.S. Treasury: Iran's inflation climbed to 90%, rial lost a quarter of value in one month
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: According to a U.S. Treasury report, Iran's annual inflation reached 90% in September; the rial has fallen 25% since August. (Source: IranIntl)
